headline: Approved the Marwood Waiver and granted three parking ticket appeals.
summary: The committee granted three parking ticket appeals. One appeal passed with 4 votes for and 1 against. The committee also approved the Marwood Waiver and the prior meeting minutes.
decisions: Granted Jay Seltzer's appeal of handicapped parking ticket #96677, with 4 votes for and 1 against.
Granted Jocelyme Jusino's appeal of no parking zone ticket #105554 unanimously.
Granted Sebastian Puchol's appeal of fire zone ticket #90138 unanimously.
Approved the August 3rd, 2026 meeting minutes unanimously.

plain_text:
City of Bristol 
PARKING AUTHORITY 
October 5th 2026  
111 North Main Street 
Bristol, CT 06010 
 
 
PRESENT:     ABSENT:      
Chairperson Andrea Adams    
James Driscoll Jr     
Michael Massarelli      
Michael Petosa 
Amy Lowrey 
Eric Bonaiuti  
 
 
1. CALL TO ORDER 
Chairperson Andrea Adams called the Parking Authority Meeting to order at 6:30 pm. 
 
 
2. PARKING TICKET APPEALS  
  
Name: Jay Seltzer  
Date ticket was issued: 09/30/2026 
Violation: Handicapped Parking  
Ticket # 96677 
Michael Massarelli made a motion to grant the appeal, second by Michael Petosa.   
Vote: Passed – 4 votes for, 1 vote against.  
  
Name: Jocelyme Jusino  
Date ticket was issued: 08/06/2026 
Violation: No Parking Zone   
Ticket #105554 
Michael Massarelli made a motion to grant the appeal, second by James Driscoll Jr.  
Vote: Unanimously Passed 
 
  
Name: Sebastian Puchol  
Date ticket was issued: 06/14/2026 
Violation: Fire Zone   
Ticket # 90138 
Michael Massarelli made a motion to grant the appeal, second by Michael Petosa.   
Vote: Unanimously Passed 
 
3. APPROVAL OF MINUTES
Michael Petosa made a motion to approve the August 3rd, 2026 meeting minutes, 
seconded by James Driscoll Jr.    
Vote: Unanimously Passed 
 
4. NEW BUSINESS 
 
a. Review Monthly Reports  
The committee reviewed and discussed the monthly parking ticket reports.  
 
b. Marwood Waiver 
Michael Petosa made a motion to approve the Marwood Waiver, seconded by Amy 
Lowrey.  
  Vote: Unanimously Passed   
 
5. OLD BUSINESS 
James Driscoll Jr informed the committee John from Laz Parking wanted to extend his 
thank you to the committee for the opportunity to speak on what they can offer the City 
of Bristol.  
 
6. ADJOURNMENT 
Michael Petosa made a motion to adjourn, second by James Driscoll Jr  
Vote: Unanimously Passed 
The Parking Authority meeting for the 5th day of October was hereby adjourned at 
6:47pm.  
Jacqueline England   
Recording Secretary
